symptom: `mxcli check tests/X.test.mdl -p app.mpr --references` fails with `module not found: MxTest`; a body calling a microflow that does not exist is never reported
cause: `CheckSource` wraps each test block as `CREATE OR MODIFY MICROFLOW MxTest.…` but nothing in the rendering created MxTest (only a run does), and the CreateMicroflowStmt reference check returns on the missing module before `validateFlowBodyReferences`
insight: A rendering checked against a project must declare everything the runner would create; an early return on the container hides every finding inside it, so a false positive here was also a false negative. `CREATE MODULE` on the first wrapper's line keeps line numbers
